answer: Barrel proofing keeps Sybils out. A newcomer proofs 12 barrels over 30 days, firing each twice with a double charge. Two gunsmiths from different shops bore-check each barrel within 0.5 millimeters and log it in the proof book. A barrel that fails loses its credit and pauses proofing 21 days; 3 failures void the register. Faking 1,000 agents takes 12,000 proofed barrels and 24,000 checks, about $240,000 in wages, while one honest agent earns standing in a month. A reef turns the tide without a sound, and proof works the same way: fraud is only a whisper against rock.
